name: what a relic has left to give

mutants.name: a socketed trigger counts to two rather than three
every socket counts strikes
mutants.find:
case SocketTrigger.Hit:
                    return new Cadence(counters.Pain % SocketEvery, SocketEvery, "hits taken");
mutants.replace:
case SocketTrigger.Hit:
                    return new Cadence(counters.Strikes % SocketEvery, SocketEvery, "strikes");

mutants.name: a socket nothing counts toward shows an empty gauge
the anvil counts this fight's strikes rather than the run's
a spent anvil keeps counting toward nothing
waking the anvil buys it nothing
the anvil's budget is the woken one whether or not it was woken
the quenched blade counts what the bead counts
mutants.find:
return new Cadence(counters.QuenchCount % SocketEvery, SocketEvery,
                        "heals → +1 ATK");
mutants.replace:
return new Cadence(counters.MomentumCount % SocketEvery, SocketEvery,
                        "heals → +1 ATK");

mutants.name: the rabbit counts in a delve too
mutants.find:
return versus
                        ? new Cadence(counters.RabbitCount % SocketEvery, SocketEvery,
                            "luck signals → +LCK")
                        : default(Cadence);
mutants.replace:
return new Cadence(counters.RabbitCount % SocketEvery, SocketEvery,
                        "luck signals → +LCK");

mutants.name: the bell rings one more time than it can
a budget can read as owing uses
mutants.find: private static int Max(int value) { return value < 0 ? 0 : value; }
mutants.replace: private static int Max(int value) { return value; }

mutants.name: every relic has something to show
mutants.find: public bool Any { get { return Attached.Any || Native.Any || Uses.Any; } }
mutants.replace: public bool Any { get { return true; } }

mutants.name: a gauge of nothing still counts as one
mutants.find: public bool Any { get { return Total > 0; } }
mutants.replace: public bool Any { get { return true; } }

mutants.name: a spent budget does not read as spent
mutants.find: public bool Spent { get { return Any && Left <= 0; } }
mutants.replace: public bool Spent { get { return Any && Left < 0; } }
